verdict.rationale: Ollama's own materials claim it can run multiple models at once and manage models through its REST API, and a hands-on user explicitly praises 'hotswapping' models without restarting the server. However, no first-party documentation describes the load, unload or switch behavior itself or confirms it happens without a restart, and the concurrency claim comes from a pricing page whose scope (local versus cloud) is unclear. missing for 10: first-party docs on loading/unloading and switching models at runtime without a server restart, documented concurrency limits and memory behavior for local multi-model loading, corroboration beyond a single community report.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
the ability to 'hotswap' models with different utility instead of restarting the server
